observations: A large dark-red heart shape sits at the center-upper face, outlined in white and filled with deep crimson, with two yellow crossed bars cutting across it.
The face is built from blocky rectangular forms in orange, yellow, and dark red, set against a mid-gray background with a loose purple arc behind the head.
A wide open mouth near the lower center shows a row of white rectangular teeth; loose multicolored lines—yellow, cyan, magenta, green—scatter across the entire surface in overlapping layers.
reading: The heart placed where eyes would normally sit creates a collision between tenderness and aggression: the crossed yellow bars read as damage or cancellation, yet the shape itself is unmistakably affectionate. Below it, the bared teeth pull in the opposite direction. The gray ground keeps the dense color from feeling celebratory, holding the image in something closer to tension than triumph.
contextAngle: Within the owned nifty-faces subset, title neighbors are nnxyz nifty faces #107 and nnxyz nifty faces #109. Both share a blocky face structure and bared-teeth mouth, but #108 is the only one in this owned group to place a heart symbol at the center of the face.

connections.reason: nnxyz nifty faces #109 shares the same blocky rectangular head and prominent white-tooth mouth bar against a warm dark ground, making the structural contrast with #108's heart placement easy to see side by side.

nnxyz nnotb #269 layers dense multicolored loose lines over a bold face structure with crossed marks inside eye zones, offering a cross-collection comparison of how the same line-over-form approach reads at higher color saturation.

lookingQuestion: Where does your eye move after landing on the heart—toward the teeth below, the crossed bars inside it, or the loose lines at the edges—and what does that path suggest about how the image is organized?
ambiguities: The orange vertical form at the lower right edge is unclear—it may be a limb, a separate figure element, or an unresolved mark.
Title-derived order and recorded-creation order align for this work in the owned subset, but gaps in the full catalogue mean no broader sequence claims can be made.
